transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I… I’m here because something’s been bothering me at school. Some staff emails, and even the morning announcements, feel like they’re… meant about me somehow. Like there are messages in them.

People say they go to everyone, and they’ve shown me that, but I still can’t quite shake the feeling.
Right now, do you believe those emails and announcements really are sending messages specifically about you?
I… yes, part of me does. I know they’re sent to everyone — people have shown me that — but I still feel like there are coded bits in them that are about me. I can’t quite let go of it.
How long have you been having this feeling that the emails and announcements contain messages specifically about you?
About four months, I think. It started… not all at once, but that’s roughly how long it’s been.
Before these experiences began, had you developed any new medical or neurological illness?
Not that I know of. I haven’t had anything new like that… at least nothing I’ve been told about.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is there?

Sometimes… yes. Not all the time. When it’s quiet at home, or after the classroom’s emptied, I’ll hear a woman’s voice say my name, or make some little comment about what I’m doing. It’s clear enough that I’ve answered before I realize there’s no one there.
Have you found yourself becoming much less emotionally expressive than you used to?

I suppose… yes, a bit. I still care about people, my students and friends and all that. But for months now I’ve felt sort of drained. Less warm, maybe. I let things slide—book club, planning theater things, even returning calls—unless someone really pushes me.
Have these experiences made it harder for you to do your job the way you used to?

A little, yes. I’m still teaching, but I’m not managing everything the way I used to. I’ve had other teachers cover parts of project lessons, and planning meetings are… harder to get through without help. Outside of work, I’ve also stopped being very reliable with book club and theater things, neighborhood events. I don’t like admitting that.
From when you first started noticing these experiences up to now, has it been six months yet?
Yes… it has. I think it started around when my youngest left for college, and that was about a year and two months ago now.
